status_of_claims.step2: computed (exploratory): floating-point developing map, IEEE double; not a proof
status_of_claims.step3: computed (interval): Krawczyk inclusion in Arb (python-flint), outward rounded; the midpoint polish and preconditioner are non-rigorous as Krawczyk allows; not a certificate
status_of_claims.step4: computed (exploratory): ratios of an interval radius to floating-point extents

definitions.m1: max over the 12 points of the angle (radians) between a point and its census image, after the best proper rotation (Kabsch; mirror first if the code is the mirror image)
definitions.m2: sup norm of (X, c) - (X0, c0) in the z-coordinates of kisscrit/certify.py after its gauge sum x0_i x x_i = 0 (the Kabsch optimum satisfies it); sigma and mu are not defined at a non-critical box point and are not included
definitions.extent: per box: max over the samples of the larger of the raw development and the development of the sample pushed onto the vertex-sum variety; per cluster: max and median over boxes
definitions.samples: box centre plus all corners when 2^(free coordinates) <= 16, else 16 seeded random corners (seed 20261021)
definitions.radius: largest rho for which the Krawczyk operator maps the cube of radius rho (in z = (X, c, sigma, mu)) into its interior; bisection bracket [accepted, rejected], ratio 1.01
